note: Hand-entered: what each memory maker committed to on its latest call, and the print that tests it. Update status and result after each print.

items.source: Fiscal Q4 2026 call (via AJ Investment Research memo, 1 Oct 2026)
items.said: Fiscal 2027 grows revenue every quarter; gross margin of about 86% in fiscal Q1 is the floor for the year.
items.test: Fiscal Q1 2027: revenue at or above the $61.5bn guidance midpoint, gross margin at least 86%, and fiscal Q2 guidance above Q1.

items.said: Supply and demand tighter in 2027 and 2028 than in 2026; industry bit growth in the low 20s % for DRAM, mid 20s % for NAND.
items.test: Repeated on the December call, and the DRAM and NAND spot indexes not falling for a month or more.

items.said: Long-term agreements with 14 customers cover more than half of 2027 and 2028 capacity, with deposits; DRAM and HBM through 2029 effectively sold out.
items.test: Q4 call: coverage held or extended to 2029, no price renegotiation, deposits not reduced.

items.said: New fabs (Yongin, M17): shells built early, clean rooms opened in phases as demand is confirmed. 2027 capex significantly higher.
items.test: 2027 capex guidance: how much is equipment rather than buildings, and is it matched by new contracted volume?

items.said: 2027 HBM sold out at agreed target prices; shortage through 2027, possibly 2028; capex mostly goes to new buildings and will not add many bits in 2028.
items.test: Q4 call: 2027 HBM prices unchanged, 2027 capex guidance not sharply above 2026's ₩84.4tn in equipment.

items.said: October–December: NAND prices broadly flat, revenue about ¥2.5tn (+0.8%), operating profit about ¥2tn; pickup expected in January–March. Next year's capacity sold; long-term hyperscaler contracts cover more than half of 2028 shipments. Unclear whether prices keep rising in fiscal 2027.
items.test: January–March guidance (early February): prices rising again and shipments picking up, as promised.

items.said: December quarter: revenue $12.2–12.6bn (+11–14%), gross margin 84.5–85.5%, EPS $55–57 (pre-split). Growth last quarter 60% volume, 40% price. Return 100% of excess cash; 50% free cash flow margin target for fiscal 2028–2030.
items.test: Late-January print: revenue at least $12.4bn and margin inside the range, despite Kioxia's flat-price outlook from the same fabs. AJ expects $59.60 EPS, above the top of the guide. 8-for-1 split from 20 November: divide pre-split figures by 8.
